segments.text: Day 122 · Transcoding: ladders, codecs, GPU farms, orchestration।
What: Converting one uploaded video into many resolution/bitrate variants (a "ladder") using codec choices and GPU-accelerated farms, orchestrated as a pipeline.
How to complete: Design a transcoding ladder (e.g.
240p–4K) for a single upload and explain how you'd orchestrate and parallelize that job across a GPU farm.
